Rules: list only companies named on the page, at most 3; 'evidence_quote' must be copied character for character from the page and name the company and what it makes or sells; copy city, state, products, certifications, MOQ, price, lead time and contact URL exactly as written on the page, or leave them null or empty; never guess, translate, round or add anything that is not on the page. If the page names no suitable company, return an empty list. Reply with the JSON object only.
